findings.title: Unknown organic versions still become complete zero totals
findings.evidence: A structurally valid organic CSV row with App ID=id6796698146 and an empty App Version produces organic_status=complete and all three organic aggregates=0. countBy puts the row in unknown, but organicComplete checks only report health.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat missing/blank version provenance as incomplete classification and leave affected organic aggregates null while retaining diagnostic row counts.
findings.suggested_test: Add blank and whitespace-only App Version fixtures, alone and mixed with a known clean row; assert unknown is never reported as a complete zero or partial total.
findings.note: The zero behavior existed before; the correction leaves it unresolved and adds an incorrect complete status.

findings.title: Future installs within the observation day count as paid
findings.evidence: With the VM clock frozen at 2026-09-05T12:00:00Z, an otherwise eligible install at 2026-09-05 23:59:00 produces paid_status=complete and paid_attributed_installs=1. The upper bound is end-of-day, not observedAt.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject installs later than the snapshot observation timestamp.
findings.suggested_test: Freeze the clock and test observedAt, observedAt plus one second, and tomorrow. The latter two must never increment accepted.

findings.title: Date-only install values acquire invented midnight precision
findings.evidence: Install Time=2026-09-04 is parsed successfully and counted as one complete paid install. Missing time-of-day cannot establish eligibility against a same-day cutoff or QA window; interpreting it as midnight can bypass QA exclusion.
findings.suggested_fix: Require a supported full timestamp and validate its calendar/time components before comparison; classify insufficient or malformed timestamps as unknown.
findings.suggested_test: Use a date-only install on a day containing an excluded QA window and assert paid_status=incomplete, total=null. Also cover impossible calendar dates and valid AppsFlyer space-separated timestamps.

findings.title: Whitespace-only media source passes paid provenance validation
findings.evidence: An otherwise eligible row with Media Source containing three spaces produces paid_status=complete and paid_attributed_installs=1. The nonempty check accepts whitespace, and the organic comparison does not reject it.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate required dimensions as nonblank after trimming without silently repairing identifiers; classify missing provenance as unknown.
findings.suggested_test: Extend the missing-dimension test at test.mjs:108-118 with whitespace-only values, especially Media Source; assert incomplete/null rather than accepted or complete zero.

verification.additional_checks: All four findings reproduced using synthetic responses in a VM with no live fetch. Baseline comparison passed for legacy root keys/schema version, report diagnostics, healthy organic aggregates and version classifications.
covered_successfully: Test, contaminated, pre-cutoff and QA-window exclusions
